answer: Someone running 142 aliases therefore needs 78 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in raven, expire in pigment, and whisper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1901 identities would post 4763 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
